findings: Events led traffic. Holiday calendar pages and individual events answered time-sensitive searches. The Dec. 5 calendar now carries the tea seating choices.
The camp directory launched with 442 programs, 231 with posted 2027 dates and prices. The sampled city, operator, topic and museum program pages are live and linked in the sitemap.
The 7-day traffic window softened while the 30-day window remained ahead. Direct or unknown referrals and international traffic were substantial, so total traffic is a broad site signal.
Saratoga showed no posted upcoming council agenda at the time of the check. The seasonal spring-break artifact and manually curated photo timestamp are known health-report notes.
The crawl correctly found the November 23 date page outside the current sitemap under the published past-date policy.
